plan.title: Increase RFQ Time with Custom Fixed Datetime

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's project page.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before accessing Settings.

args.goal: open the RFQ Settings menu, choose Extend Submission Time, select Custom Fixed time, enter 31 October 2026 04:00 AM in the custom date-time field, click Ok, and stop when the window closes and the RFQ page shows the end time as 31 October 2026 04:00 AM

steps.note: Perform the exact absolute custom fixed-time interaction that the domain extension step cannot parameterize.
Verify the expected confirmation toast appeared.
Verify the RFQ page displays the updated end datetime.
